name: ByteAsk
long_description: ByteAsk is an AI coding agent built for C and C++, the code that runs trading systems, cars, chips, and operating systems. It does not stop at a diff that looks right. ByteAsk builds, debugs, and tests every change with the real toolchain until the change holds. If the compiler, the debugger, or the tests can catch it, then ByteAsk catches it too. It runs from the terminal or inside VS Code, Neovim, and Emacs, and is available fully on-prem.
one_liner: The AI coding agent for C and C++

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Pratyush is the co-founder and CTO of ByteAsk, an AI coding tool for C and C++. He studied Computer Science at IIT Delhi. He was a core engineer on NeuralDB and BOLT, ThirdAI's CPU-only search and deep learning engines, then a founding engineer at Simbian, where he co-built the AI security agent that handles over a million incidents a year. He co-founded LawSutraAI as CTO and sold it to Manupatra, India's largest legal tech firm, where his legal research agent serves over 100,000 lawyers.
